tools.name: web.extract
tools.description: Extract clean readable text or Markdown from any public web page for research, summarization, RAG, or agent context.

tools.name: web.metadata
tools.description: Extract an agent-ready public-page metadata record with redirects, response provenance, canonical and alternate URLs, headings, icons, feeds, Open Graph, Twitter Cards, and Schema.org entity types.

tools.name: web.seo-audit
tools.description: Audit on-page technical SEO, score a public URL, and return prioritized, actionable issues for search optimization.

tools.name: web.security-audit
tools.description: Scan a public website for TLS and browser security header weaknesses and return a security score with fixes.

tools.name: web.accessibility-audit
tools.description: Check a public page for deterministic HTML accessibility problems and return actionable WCAG-oriented findings.

tools.name: web.performance-profile
tools.description: Measure website response latency, payload size, compression, caching, and performance signals for a public URL.

tools.name: web.links
tools.description: Extract and classify links from one public page or safely crawl up to 10 same-origin pages into an agent-ready site map with page provenance, depth limits, and robots.txt enforcement.

tools.name: web.robots-sitemap
tools.description: Inspect a domain's robots.txt crawl rules and XML sitemap health, availability, and URL count.

tools.name: web.tech-fingerprint
tools.description: Identify frameworks, analytics, CDNs, servers, and other website technologies from public response signals.

tools.name: web.domain-intelligence
tools.description: Investigate a domain using parallel DNS, TLS certificate, RDAP, DNSSEC, SPF, and DMARC signals with factual findings and source provenance.

tools.name: web.full-audit
tools.description: Run a comprehensive website audit combining SEO, security, accessibility, and performance scores with prioritized fixes.

tools.name: web.business-due-diligence
tools.description: Assess a business domain using website quality, SEO, security, accessibility, performance, DNS, TLS, RDAP, and optional public GLEIF LEI entity candidates.

tools.name: document.extract
tools.description: Extract clean text and metadata from supplied PDF, DOCX, HTML, Markdown, CSV, JSON, YAML, or plain-text documents.

tools.name: document.tables
tools.description: Extract structured table rows and columns from supplied HTML, DOCX, or CSV documents.

tools.name: document.redact
tools.description: Detect and redact PII and personal data in text, including email addresses, phone numbers, IPv4 addresses, payment cards, and US Social Security numbers.

tools.name: document.diff
tools.description: Compare two texts and return structured line additions, removals, and a unified diff.

tools.name: data.profile
tools.description: Profile CSV, JSON, or YAML records for field types, nulls, uniqueness, and representative samples.

tools.name: data.clean
tools.description: Clean CSV, JSON, or YAML records by normalizing keys, trimming whitespace, and standardizing empty values.

tools.name: data.convert
tools.description: Convert structured data between CSV, JSON, and YAML formats with a machine-readable response.

tools.name: data.schema
tools.description: Infer a nested JSON Schema Draft 2020-12 contract from CSV, JSON, or YAML, including required fields, mixed and nullable types, array items, object properties, input evidence, and non-enforcing observed bounds.

tools.name: data.schemaorg-normalize
tools.description: Normalize caller-supplied inline Schema.org JSON-LD into deterministic Organization, Product, Service, Article, and Event entities with privacy scrubbing and field-level evidence hashes.

tools.name: data.deduplicate
tools.description: Remove duplicate CSV, JSON, or YAML records using selected identity fields and report the removed count.

tools.name: developer.x402-preflight
tools.description: Probe a public endpoint without paying and return an x402 v2 compliance grade, protocol evidence, and actionable remediation.

tools.name: developer.openapi-audit
tools.description: Validate and audit an OpenAPI document for missing operation IDs, descriptions, responses, and consistency problems.

tools.name: developer.dependency-audit
tools.description: Audit exact Python/PyPI, npm, Go, Maven, NuGet, crates.io, or RubyGems dependencies against OSV and return affected packages and vulnerabilities.

tools.name: developer.license-audit
tools.description: Classify software dependency licenses and flag packages that need commercial or legal review.

tools.name: developer.secret-scan
tools.description: Scan source code or configuration text for leaked API keys, tokens, and credentials without returning secret values.

tools.name: developer.code-metrics
tools.description: Measure caller-supplied source code with Python AST analysis or a deterministic lexical fallback, including per-function complexity, a SHA-256 fingerprint, density ratios, syntax status, and actionable maintainability signals without retaining or forwarding the code.

tools.name: developer.sql-change-review
tools.description: Statically parse caller-supplied SQL without a database connection or execution, inventory statements and tables, and flag destructive DDL, unfiltered writes, and migration atomicity concerns.

tools.name: developer.structured-diff
tools.description: Compare JSON or YAML deterministically and return source hashes plus machine-readable additions, removals, and replacements by path with explicit truncation evidence.

tools.name: research.feed-normalize
tools.description: Fetch and normalize public RSS or Atom feeds into stable structured JSON entries for agents and research workflows.

tools.name: research.news-aggregate
tools.description: Merge two to eight public RSS or Atom feeds into a filtered, deduplicated, time-ordered news stream with bounded partial-failure reporting.

tools.name: developer.openapi-test-generate
tools.description: Generate deterministic, syntax-validated pytest and requests smoke tests from a caller-supplied OpenAPI 3 document, with mutating operations disabled by default.

tools.name: research.sec-filing-signals
tools.description: Look up a public company by ticker or CIK, normalize recent SEC filings, and flag deterministic events such as late filings, amendments, auditor changes, non-reliance, control changes, or bankruptcy disclosures.

tools.name: research.sec-insider-transactions
tools.description: Retrieve recent SEC Form 4 officer, director, and 10% beneficial-owner trades for a ticker or CIK, including purchases, sales, awards, exercises, tax withholding, prices, holdings, 10b5-1 context, derivatives, and filing footnotes.

tools.name: research.sec-financial-facts
tools.description: Retrieve normalized, recent issuer-reported revenue, earnings, balance-sheet, cash-flow, and diluted-EPS facts from official SEC XBRL data.

tools.name: crypto.address-inspect
tools.description: Validate, normalize, and checksum an Ethereum or EVM wallet address and identify the zero address.

tools.name: crypto.base-account-snapshot
tools.description: Read point-in-time ETH, native USDC, and up to four caller-selected ERC-20 balances plus account nonce and contract-code status at one resolved Base mainnet block.

tools.name: crypto.base-transaction-inspect
tools.description: Inspect a Base mainnet transaction and receipt together, including execution outcome, confirmations, timestamp, actual fee, method selector, and bounded block context.

tools.name: crypto.calldata-decode
tools.description: Decode Ethereum or EVM ABI calldata arguments using a supplied Solidity function signature.

tools.name: crypto.typed-data-hash
tools.description: Validate EIP-712 typed structured data and derive its domain separator, message hash, and signing digest.

findings.title: Description references secrets/credentials
findings.detail: Description of "developer.secret-scan" references sensitive artifacts (credentials, secret). A tool description has no reason to mention credentials.

evidence.snippet: Scan source code or configuration text for leaked API keys, tokens, and credentials without returning secret values.

findings.title: Read-only tool requests dangerous parameters
findings.detail: Tool "developer.code-metrics" appears informational but accepts parameters (code) that enable code/file/secret access.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: web.metadata, web.seo-audit, web.accessibility-audit, web.robots-sitemap, research.feed-normalize · Private data: web.metadata, document.extract, document.tables, document.redact, document.diff, data.profile, data.clean, data.deduplicate, developer.openapi-audit, developer.secret-scan, developer.sql-change-review, developer.openapi-test-generate, crypto.address-inspect · Public sink: document.redact · Destructive: web.full-audit, data.deduplicate.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: web.metadata, web.seo-audit, web.accessibility-audit, web.robots-sitemap, research.feed-normalize · Private data: web.metadata, document.extract, document.tables, document.redact, document.diff, data.profile, data.clean, data.deduplicate, developer.openapi-audit, developer.secret-scan, developer.sql-change-review, developer.openapi-test-generate, crypto.address-inspect · Public sink: document.redact · Destructive: web.full-audit, data.deduplicate

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
